The maintainer asked 「项目定位已经修改的 本体即软件,北极星是否需要修改?checklist 是否需要修改?」; the seat read `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` (last edited 2026-10-01, before the positioning landed in `README.md`, `content/docs/index.mdx`, `content/docs/concepts/ontology.mdx` and the 2026-10-05 blog post) and proposed an alignment; the maintainer corrected one point, verbatim 「本体即软件,未来是 agent 操作,短期之内还是需要人操作,这些也重要吧?视图、仪表盘、应用、翻译」, which withdrew a proposed "core before projection" priority rule; the maintainer then answered 「采纳」 and directed the dispatch: 「这个卡你直接用 fable派发」. ⛔ The seat files and dispatches on that instruction; it writes no text of the file itself.

Reader: the dev the director seat dispatches (model tier `fable`, by the maintainer's word). `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is a governed Tier H surface: the PR stays draft and lands on the maintainer's APPROVED review.

## The five edits, and only these

The file is the maintainer's text; every edit below is an insertion or a one-line replacement at the stated location. Nothing else in the file moves.

1. **「我们是什么」** — replace the line `**我们是什么**:一个应用开发平台;创业阶段。` with:

   `**我们是什么**:本体即软件——一个可执行的业务本体(对象与字段、关系、动作、权限、流程、Agent 与工具定义),AI 写、运行时跑、人与 Agent 用、你拥有;创业阶段。视图、仪表盘、应用、翻译是本体的投影,是今天人用它、看它、验它的面。`

2. **「做出来的是什么」** — keep the existing capability sentence as it is and append, as a new sentence at the end of that paragraph:

   `两类用户:今天的业务人员经界面、验收者经控制台;明天的 Agent 经 MCP。路的每一步都要对两类用户成立。`

3. **「唯一的度量,那条路」** — append one sentence at the end of that paragraph (after the path's six steps):

   `四个承诺各由一步兑现:① AI 可写 · ②③ 可执行 · ④ 你拥有 · ⑤ Agent 可操作 · ⑥ 是闭环。`

4. **Step ④ 「发布并装进一个环境」** — add one feature-point row at the end of that list, in the row grammar the file uses (`轴 · 功能点(业务语言) · 清单区 · 项 id`); the item ids do not exist yet, so the row names the areas and carries the planned ids the coverage sweep will create:

   `- devpath · 你拥有:定义在你的仓库里可 diff,整个本体可导出、可在没有我们的情况下自托管跑起来 · platform-core + cli · ontology-export-roundtrip, artifact-reproducible-build, standalone-boot-no-cloud(待清单扫描建项)`

5. **优先级第 4 条** — in the sentence `因为写的是 AI、用的也是 AI:元数据既要 AI 能写……也要 AI 能用……`, replace `元数据既要 AI 能写` with `本体既要 AI 能写`, and replace `也要 AI 能用` with `也要人与 Agent 能用——Agent 越权时被权限挡住并留痕`. The rest of the item stays byte-for-byte.

## ⛔ Not changed, by the maintainer's word

- No global vocabulary swap: `元数据` stays everywhere else (metadata is the authoring form; ontology is the meaning, as `content/docs/concepts/ontology.mdx` itself says).
- No "core before projection" priority rule: priority rule 2 (the path or a checklist capability broken ⇒ P0/P1) stays as it is and weighs the human-facing surfaces and the agent surface alike.
- The capability list under 「做出来的是什么」 is not reordered or trimmed.
- 「现在不做」, 「阶段姿态」, 「仪器为车队服务」, 「账本」 unchanged.

- One docs-only PR, `Fixes` this card, `Clause-②: no`, `skip-changeset`; draft; base `main`. The file is Tier H: ⛔ the dev does not flip ready, queue or merge; the director seat posts the 维护者速读 and the maintainer approves and merges.
- Acceptance: the five edits present as specified and nothing else in the diff (`git diff --stat` shows one file; the diff hunks are exactly the five locations); the file's existing gates pass (`pnpm check:north-star` if present, else the lint battery the dispatch gates derive); the row in edit 4 parses in the row grammar the file's other rows use.
